chapterInfo.content:
8
Dawid nkonimdie ne ne mpanimfoɔ atitire
(1 Berɛsosɛm 18.1-17)
1 # 1 Be 18 Na yei akyiri no, Dawid ko dii Filistifoɔ so, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn ase, na Dawid gyee Metegamma firii Filistifoɔ nsam. 2Na ɔkaa Moab nso gui, na ɔmaa wɔdedaa fam akuo mmiɛnsa. Na wɔkumm nnipa akuo no mu mmienu, na wɔgyaa ekuo baako sɛ wɔntena ase. Na Moabfoɔ bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkoa a wɔtua apeatoɔ ma no. 3Dawid kaa Sobahene Rehob ba Hadadeser nso gui, ɛberɛ a ɔkɔɔ sɛ ɔrema ne tumi akɔso Asubɔntene Eufrate ho no mu. 4#Yos 11.9 Na Dawid kyeree wɔn apɔnkɔsotefoɔ no mu apem ahanson ne anammɔnmufoɔ mpem aduonu, na Dawid twitwaa nteaseɛnam apɔnkɔ nyinaa nantin ntini, na ɔgyaa wɔn mu nteaseɛnam ɔha deɛ. 5Na Damasko Siriafoɔ baa sɛ wɔrebɛboa Sobahene Hadadeser no, Dawid kumm Siriafoɔ no mu nnipa mpem aduonu mmienu. 6Ɛnna Dawid de bansifoɔ kɔtenaa Damasko a ɛwɔ Siria, na Siria yɛɛ Dawid nkoa a wɔtua apeatoɔ. Na AWURADE boaa Dawid maa no dii nim wɔ baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ nyinaa. 7Na Dawid gyegyee sika akyɛm a na Hadadeser nkoa kura no de baa Yerusalem. 8Na Ɔhene Dawid faa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ pii pa firii Hadadeser nkuro Beta ne Berotai mu.
9Na Hamathene Toi tee sɛ Dawid aka Hadadeser dɔm nyinaa aguo no, 10Toi somaa ne ba Yoram baa Ɔhene Dawid nkyɛn bɛkyeaa no maa no amo, sɛ ɔne Hadadeser ako na waka no aguo, ɛfiri sɛ na Hadadeser ne Toi di ako. Na Yoram kura dwetɛ nnwinneɛ ne sika nnwinneɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnwinneɛ de bae. 11Ɛno nso na Ɔhene Dawid de yɛɛ akronkronneɛ maa AWURADE, sɛ dwetɛ ne sika a ɛfiri amanaman a ɔbrɛɛ wɔn aseɛ no nyinaa mu a ɔde yɛɛ akronkronneɛ no, 12ɛfiri Edom, Moab, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Amalekfoɔ ne Sobahene Rehob ba Hadadeser asadeɛ no mu.
13 # Dwom 60.1 Na Dawid sane firii Siriafoɔ kum no, ɔde gyee din wɔ Nkyene-bonhwa mu sɛ ɔkumm Edomfoɔ mpem dunwɔtwe. 14#Gye 27.40 Na ɔde asraafoɔ bansifoɔ tenaa Edom; Edom nyinaa mu na ɔde bansifoɔ tenatenaeɛ, na Edomfoɔ nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkoa. Na AWURADE boaa Dawid maa no dii nim baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ nyinaa.
15Na Dawid dii Israel nyinaa so hene; na Dawid de atɛntenenee ne tenenee dii asɛm maa ne manfoɔ nyinaa. 16#2 Sa 20.23-26 Na Seruia ba Yoab na na ɔdi asraafoɔ dɔm no soɔ, na Ahilud ba Yehosafat ne deɛ ɔtwerɛ nsɛm de sie, 17na Ahitub ba Sadok ne Abiatar ba Ahimelek ne asɔfoɔ, na Seraia ne ɔtwerɛfoɔ, 18#2 Sa 15.18; 1 Sa 30.14; 1 Be 18.17; 1 Ah 4.5 na Yoiada ba Benaia na na ɔdi Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ#8.18 KERETIFOƆ ne PELETIFOƆ: Yeinom yɛ asraafoɔ a wɔabɔ wɔn paa di dwuma bi. no soɔ, na Dawid mma ne asɔfoɔ.

Na yei akyiri no, Dawid ko dii Filistifoɔ so, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn ase, na Dawid gyee Metegamma firii Filistifoɔ nsam. Na ɔkaa Moab nso gui, na ɔmaa wɔdedaa fam akuo mmiɛnsa. Dawid kaa Sobahene Rehob ba Hadadeser nso gui, ɛberɛ a ɔkɔɔ sɛ ɔrema ne tumi akɔso Asubɔntene Eufrate ho no mu. Na Damasko Siriafoɔ baa sɛ wɔrebɛboa Sobahene Hadadeser no, Dawid kumm Siriafoɔ no mu nnipa mpem aduonu mmienu. Ɛnna Dawid de bansifoɔ kɔtenaa Damasko a ɛwɔ Siria, na Siria yɛɛ Dawid nkoa a wɔtua apeatoɔ. Na AWURADE boaa Dawid maa no dii nim wɔ baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ nyinaa. Na Dawid gyegyee sika akyɛm a na Hadadeser nkoa kura no de baa Yerusalem. Na Ɔhene Dawid faa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ pii pa firii Hadadeser nkuro Beta ne Berotai mu.
Na Hamathene Toi tee sɛ Dawid aka Hadadeser dɔm nyinaa aguo no, Toi somaa ne ba Yoram baa Ɔhene Dawid nkyɛn bɛkyeaa no maa no amo, sɛ ɔne Hadadeser ako na waka no aguo, ɛfiri sɛ na Hadadeser ne Toi di ako. Na Dawid sane firii Siriafoɔ kum no, ɔde gyee din wɔ Nkyene-bonhwa mu sɛ ɔkumm Edomfoɔ mpem dunwɔtwe. Na ɔde asraafoɔ bansifoɔ tenaa Edom; Edom nyinaa mu na ɔde bansifoɔ tenatenaeɛ, na Edomfoɔ nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkoa. Na AWURADE boaa Dawid maa no dii nim baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ nyinaa.
Na Dawid dii Israel nyinaa so hene; na Dawid de atɛntenenee ne tenenee dii asɛm maa ne manfoɔ nyinaa. Na Seruia ba Yoab na na ɔdi asraafoɔ dɔm no soɔ, na Ahilud ba Yehosafat ne deɛ ɔtwerɛ nsɛm de sie, na Ahitub ba Sadok ne Abiatar ba Ahimelek ne asɔfoɔ, na Seraia ne ɔtwerɛfoɔ, na Yoiada ba Benaia na na ɔdi Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ no soɔ, na Dawid mma ne asɔfoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
